text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My… How did I come to arrive here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To think that I, of all people, could have been that distracted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The statue of the Three Goddesses… The air about them feels… different from usual.
